verdict.rationale: Groq's docs explicitly instruct developers to point OpenAI SDK clients at Groq by only changing api_key and base_url to https://api.groq.com/openai/v1, and a live probe confirms the OpenAI-style /v1/models endpoint is functional. This is corroborated by consistent documentation across chat completions, streaming, tool use, and structured outputs all using OpenAI SDK conventions. Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation of a drop-in swap working flawlessly in production (community evidence focuses on speed/reliability rather than compatibility specifics).
